name: Samsung
summary:
Samsung’s wordmark is the tab icon on samsung.com. Phone and TV product pages on that host share it. The file below is the one the US shop response returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against samsung.com. HTML came from https://www.samsung.com/us/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: apple-touch-icon → https://www.samsung.com/etc.clientlibs/samsung/clientlibs/consumer/global/clientlib-common/resources/pwa/icon/pwa_icon_192x192.png; icon 96x96 → https://resources.samsung.com/etc.clientlibs/samsung/clientlibs/consumer/global/clientlib-common/resources/images/Favicon.png; shortcut icon → https://resources.samsung.com/etc.clientlibs/samsung/clientlibs/consumer/global/clientlib-common/resources/images/Favicon.png; apple-touch-icon 144x144 → https://resources.samsung.com/etc.clientlibs/samsung/clientlibs/consumer/global/clientlib-common/resources/images/app_ico.png.

No favicon.ico URL returned an image on 12 November 2026. samsung.com did not pass the image check for an .ico path. Formats that did save: png.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.samsung.com/etc.clientlibs/samsung/clientlibs/consumer/global/clientlib-common/resources/pwa/icon/pwa_icon_192x192.png, measured at 192×192 png.

Brand colour #0c4da2 comes from the theme-color meta tag.

Largest measured bitmap: png-192x192-01.png at 192×192 (png, 3939 bytes) from https://www.samsung.com/etc.clientlibs/samsung/clientlibs/consumer/global/clientlib-common/resources/pwa/icon/pwa_icon_192x192.png.
